data.name: Equatic
data.description: Equatic is a carbon removal company combining carbon dioxide removal and green hydrogen production, using patented seawater electrolysis and a direct air capture process to activate and amplify the ocean's ability to store carbon. The UCLA spin-out operates pilot plants in Los Angeles and Singapore and is expanding with a demonstration plant in Singapore (Equatic-1) and a commercial-scale plant in Canada.
